import json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
d=json.load(open('coverage.json'))
files=[f['file'] for f in d['frames']]
print(len(files))
# crop to top-right region where the graphic lives, label, tile 3 cols
tiles=[]
for f in files:
    im=Image.open(f).convert('RGB').crop((960,0,1920,540))
    dr=ImageDraw.Draw(im); dr.rectangle([0,0,960,30],fill=(0,0,0)); dr.text((6,6),f,fill=(255,255,0))
    tiles.append(im)
cols=3; per=12
for s in range(0,len(tiles),per):
    chunk=tiles[s:s+per]; rows=(len(chunk)+cols-1)//cols
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(960*cols,540*rows))
    for i,t in enumerate(chunk): sheet.paste(t,((i%cols)*960,(i//cols)*540))
    sheet.save('/tmp/sheet%d.jpg'%(s//per),quality=80)
EOF
